messages:
maria: RC candidate ready for promo: rc/2026-03-21-7. Artifact: build-rc-2026.03.21-7. Can we cut promo in the 13:20-13:40 change window? Smoke + reg tests green.
kevin: QA sign-off? any late changes to be aware of?
aj: QA signed off @13:02. Full regression suite passed. KV warm job queued. No blocking issues.
deploy-bot: deploy request queued: rc/2026-03-21-7 -> prod. Requested by maria. Change window reserved 13:20-13:40. Approvals recorded: maria, kevin.
sarah: heads-up — security flagged an IAM policy tweak that landed in a PR an hour ago. Not required for this RC but recommended. Prefer hotpatch after promo if we proceed.
maria: proposal: promote with staged rollout (10% for 15m) and hold IAM for a follow-up hotpatch. Rollback target: v2026.03.14 if we see regressions. Thoughts?
kevin: sounds good. DB migration is backward-compatible (flag default off). Hotpatch ok after prod promo.
aj: I'll run the staged rollout and monitor traces/alerts. I set envoy weight to 10% for canary.
deploy-bot: initiating canary: 10% -> rc/2026-03-21-7. Canary health checks: 0 failing checks. KV cache warm ~75%.
maria: monitor SLOs (latency p95, error rate) for 15m. Abort criteria: error rate >0.5% OR p95 latency increase >50ms.
kevin: adding release note snippet: "KV cache and perf improvements; opt-in DB migration; minor security hardening forthcoming (hotpatch)." Will publish when promo completes.
sarah: running quick IAM smoke against canary. No auth regressions observed at +8m.
aj: canary metrics at +12m: error rate 0.02%, p95 +3ms, traces look clean. Logs: `tail -n 50 /var/log/service/canary.log | grep ERROR` -> empty.
deploy-bot: canary passed at +15m. Proceeding ramp: 50% -> 100% in 5m steps.
maria: proceeding with full promote unless anyone objects.
kevin: no objections. go ahead.
deploy-bot: promotion complete. rc/2026-03-21-7 -> 100% prod at 13:37 UTC. Post-deploy checks: smoke OK, 0 errors in 10k requests, KV warming at 98%.
aj: executing postdeploy smoke: `for i in {1..10000}; do curl -sS -XGET https://api/health >/dev/null; done` -> 0 failures.
sarah: security will follow up with the IAM hotpatch PR; no immediate issues.
maria: closing promo. Follow-up actions: kevin to publish release notes and changelog; aj to run midnight regression sweep; sarah to verify hotpatch window. Thanks all :tada:
